notes.title: Development Update - 6th August 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!

The past few weeks you may have noticed that there hasn't been much happening on the update front, that's because I'm enjoying my summer break a bit :) Been crunching updates quite hard the past few months so wanted to take some time off as I'm in and out of the country for a few more weeks.

I'm still working hard on the next bit of the content and I think you'll enjoy it as soon as it's finished!

So today we'll talk a bit about this new feature, that being: [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Expeditions[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/981b84bf24fc027da765812b8d415f4dde32dd6d.gif"][/img][/p][p]The shrouded isles will be opening up the mists for any travellers seeking to explore their fractured lands![/p][p][/p][h3]What is it?[/h3][p][/p][p]Expeditions will be a timed minigame where the player can board a boat and sail around the isles.[/p][p]The player has 15 minutes to explore and scavenge as much as they can before being pulled out of the mists.[/p][p]This content will be available from the very start of the game and you will have to get more powerful to be handle to handle higher difficulties. It is primarily meant as an alternative method of gathering more strength if you are really getting stuck on the story mode.[/p][p][/p][h3]How does it work?[/h3][p][/p][p]You will have to get familiar with the layout of the isles and try to find your bearings. You will be dropped into a random starting point so that you'll have to adjust your route accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p]You can board any isles by sailing onto the docking point (which is the blue marked spot with the white arrow shown above). You can re-enter your boat by simply clicking your boat whenever you return to the dockpoint.[/p][p][/p][p]When you are on an island, you can smash pots and jars to retrieve plunder. Plunder is the new currency which you can spend on account upgrades and unlocks - more information on this I won't be sharing and you can see these for yourself when this content unlocks.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/104485572ed9274ff239bf564d8e51d3afcb07d5.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Difficulty Unlock?[/h3][p][/p][p]As you may have noticed, there is a counter for "Difficulty Unlock".[/p][p]You will not be able to head straight into the hardest difficulty and farm out as much plunder as you can there. You will have to fully "beat" your highest current difficulty tier to be able to progress into the next. This is to prevent abuse.[/p][p][/p][p]Difficulty can be changed by talking to Captain Hicks outside the Isles entrance:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/8d9ba2de3bf3e3cb7b47d6c8142f7f8a34d2af5e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]So how do you "complete" an expedition?[/p][p][/p][p]You will be looking to find warded chests scattered across different isles:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/9a16a0d3a7277c962785fe019888061693da2683.png"][/img][/p][p]Hitting these chests will start a combat trial. Enemies will spawn in waves and you must defeat them all to lift the ward on the chest. Once you've done this, you may hit the chest again to retrieve the rewards. These chests contain much more plunder than the average jars/pots you will be smashing and contain various other rewards, which I won't detail just yet.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the type of rewards however, is ship upgrade materials![/p][p][/p][p]Defeating 10 of these chest trials within the 15 minute time limit will mark your expedition difficulty as complete, and you will unlock the next difficulty.[/p][p][/p][p]Note that more trials are in development (such as bosses and puzzle events).[/p][p][/p][h3]The ship[/h3][p][/p][p]With these ship upgrade materials mentioned above, you can also upgrade your boat at Captain Hicks:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/d7ded7a5a18d95da9d4ad6f63e4c740421528f5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Upgrading your ship will make your ship more durable (for possible events that may cause you harm.....) and increase its speed, making it easier to navigate the mists within the time limit![/p][p][/p][p]I am still looking into options to be able to visually upgrade your ship as well (+customizing it), but I have no progress on that one just yet.[/p][p][/p][h3]Summary[/h3][p][/p][p]So, that is what will be coming to Incursion2D soon.[/p][p]I'm still making much of the islands, and I'm still working on many features for it:[/p][list][*][p]Random events[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses[/p][/*][*][p]The rewards (Both power-ups and cosmetics)[/p][/*][*][p]...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]So I can't give an exact timeframe yet, especially with me being on a general break at this time.[/p][p]This content is aimed at everyone, not just end-gamers and is solo-focussed in contrary to the dungeons at end-game.[/p][p][/p][p]Of course I will still apply hotfixes if any bugs show up in current builds so reach out on Discord if you are experiencing any issues![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading and see you on the isles soon,[/p]

[*] A new type of melee combo move is available: Combo Point Moves
Focusses on a less-spammy combat style
Rewards parrying and perfect shielding by granting combo points for succesful counters
Once you have combo points, you can hold your attack to start charging your melee move
You can either spend a single point on a light move, or spend all 4 points on a strong move
[*] "Finesse" is a new Combo Point move which can be purchased from the hunting shop for 20 rabbit pelts
Light attack: Cutting Axe
Heavy attack: Thousand Cuts
[*] An addition astral dummy was added that will grant you +1 Combo Point (CP) upon hitting it
[*] Events can now be started manually by staff
[/list]

[h3]CHANGED:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Goblin brutes have been nerfed slightly to where they will only stun you if you get hit during their sprint
[*] Players have had their physics density increased making it so enemies can no longer "push" you into positions that will get you stuck
[*] Enemies will now be harder to group up, they will slow down if other enemies are in front of them already heading to you
[*] Enemies can now be pushed back easier, making it more unlikely for the player to get stuck in a mob unfairly
[*] "M. Fragments" was an incorrect label inside smithing and has been adjusted to simply "Metal"
[*] Some return points to the weathered woods town have been adjusted to prevent players from getting stuck in homes
[*] The hitbox on the frozen status of the player has been adjusted so that it should be more consistent for the player to be broken free again if an enemy hits the ice
[*] Selecting a party member by clicking their actual character made it so you could target them that way - clicking them again would then unselect them. This didn't feel good so you can no longer unselect a party member that way. You can simply select another target or click them via the party frames to unselect them.
[*] Astral dummies in the attunement room will now sync up their combat timers. If one dummy expires but you're fighting another one, your old one will no longer cancel your combat status.
[/list]

[h3]FIXED:[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you didn't talk to Finley in the Empire before reaching the frozen north, his ghost marker will no longer appear in town
[*] If you had an older savefile which didn't have magic abilities unlocked yet, it will now auto-unlock for you if you've beaten the second boss
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update - 11th June 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hello once again!

In the last post we mentioned that the beta for chapter 3 would be ongoing internally and we discussed some of the release dates.
I'm happy to report that the beta over the past 3 months has looked quite promising and that we are ready to move ahead to the release of this new chapter! While there is still work to be done, everything is stable enough to the point where we can grab more feedback as more players start to get their hands on it.

Once again, for those only interested in timelines:[/p][list][*][p][b]Chapter 3 will release on June 23rd, 2025![/b][/p][/*][/list][p]For those interested in reading some of the changes since the last blog, let's go over the implementation overview![/p][p][/p][h2]Multiplayer[/h2][p][/p][h3]Party system[/h3][p]Adding onto the multiplayer experience, it is now possible to form parties up to 3 players to be able to see each other in combat areas. This change came after it became too strong to have more than 3 players in a combat room be able to heal you. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/3b9660413796df5837f746bd95791d23ba27d709.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Dungeons[/h3][p]In the first iterations I mentioned that multiplayer would be visual only. This later evolved into also being able to heal/buff other players. In the latest version it is possible to form parties and take on dungeons! At this time there is only 1 but the foundation has been laid to make more without too much hassle. Dungeons are content for parties of minimum 2 players that must battle through multiple rooms before reaching the boss.[/p][p][/p][p]Dungeons will award the player with dungeon credits which can be spent on various items at the dungeon store! I won't reveal too much, but here is one of the awesome spells you can buy:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/ebaccb56ae84729b9e43331cdfe158b3130b84d9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each party member must defeat their local room with enemies that only they can see. You can still buff/heal eachother however. The twist in this case is that the arena will shoot multiplayer abilities at you that are synced up between you and your party members, so you must all deal with the same mechanic.[/p][p][/p][p]Once all players are ready with their room, the door to next opens up. You must defeat 4 of these rooms before reaching the boss room! The boss is a fully server-driven multiplayer fight. The boss will switch targets and fire mechanics that affects everyone! Working together to take it down therefore is an absolute must![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/48952b47506ac7a255f26344160a4c5b85cb485e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Targettable spells[/h3][p]A new type of ability you can do is a target-spell. You can select your party members while you're in combat, which will display a small green arrow above your target. Firing the spell will then apply to your current target. If no target is selected, the spell applies to yourself![/p][p][/p][h3]Server events[/h3][p]Every hour, on the hour - a 15 minute event will be sent to all players (online mode only!). These will be events that will make it easier for you to level up your skills, or apply modifiers that make it easier to gather rare resources. More and more events will get added over time![/p][p][/p][h3]Player list[/h3][p]No longer would you need to spam global chat to check for other players! Simply hit your escape key and observe the player list in the pause menu! This way you don't have to be paranoid on whether you are alone or not![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/9bc88915931e01f23cd16387e853f653a6d6226e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Hero Ranks[/h3][p]Hero Ranks have been in the game for a while, and were achievable by reaching Arena Rank 5 in each chapter's arena. However the concept was too limited and has now been expanded. Rather than having a maximum of rank 11, the max rank has been increased to 32 and new icons have been added to make it a bit more crisp. You can now view which Hero Ranks you can still earn by opening the Rank Log. These ranks will now dictate how far you are into the game, leading into the next topic![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/ddb24a7e64e9622f579484f7a672f09bb5d036b4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Leaderboard[/h3][p]... Leaderboards! And no, not the simplified Steam Leaderboard which can get exploited! This is a custom server that will gather all your player statistics from any of the current live servers. Players will get sorted based on their Hero Rank first, and their actual player level second. It will show the top 100 of players![/p][p]You can access this leaderboard while you're online in any city, or from your stats menu in the inventory![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/b2ae78fb123bbb8ba9c75200705287436088ad22.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Bosses[/h2][p][/p][h3]Hardcore additions[/h3][p]All the bosses of chapter 2 have had hardcore modes added! For chapter 3 currently only the second boss has a hardcore mode, with the final 3 to be added in the near future. I've decided to not let this delay the new chapter release since they can be simply part of weekly updates. In relation to the hardcore mode drops, a secret recipe can be unlocked through rare drops which will require hardcore boss materials to build![/p][p][/p][h2]Combat[/h2][p][/p][h3]Reworked tutorial[/h3][p]To help better introduce new players to the mechanics of the game, the tutorial has been reworked entirely. If you would like to experience it but you already have a savefile, you could temporarily move your save file to another location to give it a shot! Hopefully this will better convey the combat to new players.[/p][p][/p][h3]Perfect shielding[/h3][p]Parrying an enemy has always felt decently snappy. Unfortunately there was no similar feeling for stopping most enemy ranged attacks. That stops today! Introducing - Perfect Shields! This new mechanic will make it so that players have a small window when hitting their block button that will trigger the perfect shield, causing enemy projectiles to explode and for the player to receive a stamina regeneration boost! Missing your window however will cause the mechanic to enter a cooldown![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/4b321a491aa76a3f6d75a2d3ee723c1cc7997ca2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]
The wandering trader[/h3][p]Ever ran out of potions before taking on your new bossfight? That's everyone - probably. When you now clear the room just before the new boss, a wandering trader will now appear that will sell you potions, so you can now die and blame something else other than running out of potions![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/7fba91455b05c88875d67049b48bb59504452e90.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]The attunement combat chamber[/h3][p]Previously the attunement chamber was meant solely for changing out your abilities. Now you will find that a new portal has opened up to the north of the book. This new room will let you practice blocking/perfect-shielding harmless projectiles, swap out spells, and try out your abilities without any cost/cooldown! Feel free to spam away at the army of astral dummies![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/76ec2d75293bd8fd512f9572ef12fb9320e2bf2f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Visual makeovers (frogs + wildlife)[/h3][p]Not much exciting here, but still worth a mention! The visual representation of the frogs and the wildlife have always been underwhelming. Their graphics have been swapped around to be a bit more fitting to the rest of the game. This means that any pets you've had from these monsters will also have been updated![/p][p][/p][h3]Third ability slot[/h3][p]A pretty big change is that you will now be able to wear 3 active magic abilities. Rather than giving you two slots upon defeating the nature golem, you will now get one slot per chapter. Since the new chapter introduces a boat load of new spells, this was a welcome change.[/p][p][/p][h3]Stances[/h3][p]One type of that boatload of new spells, are stance spells. These are spells that can be activated and deactivated as you please. These spells will increase certain stats as long as you have the stamina to fuel it! Having a stance activate burns through stamina rather quickly, so these are great for burst-opportunities. It also gives a decent endgame purpose to still levelling up your stamina in the late-game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/8ed089ffca750675517ff7c0c8c2139bbdca3961.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Stat chest reward reworks[/h3][p]Previously, if you capped out the chests you get from clearing a room of monsters, you would receive a chest that simply displayed "CAPPED", meaning you could not get a reward from that chest.
This has now been reworked so that if you've capped out a certain stat, that slot will be replaced with a random reward. This could be any of the following:[/p][list][*][p]Recipes[/p][/*][*][p]Seeds[/p][/*][*][p]Pet Chance (Low chance, but if you see this option it's a guaranteed random pet!)[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Gold[/p][/*][/list][h2]Cosmetics[/h2][p][/p][h3]Dragons[/h3][p]Speaking of pets, prepare for a brand new type of pet! Dragon eggs have been added to the MTX store. These eggs will evolve as follows: Egg -> Cracked Egg -> Drake -> Adolescent Dragon -> Dragon -> Ancient Dragon. You must have these pets out in their latest stage to be able to "age" them into the next stage. Founders have had their founder's drake converted into this new type of pet! More dragons will become available (for free of course), with the introduction of chapter 4.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/393f4d6b4cab291f41af3449d2090cb597e38c22.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Eyetrails[/h3][p]A new type of cosmetic is also available now - that being eyetrails. These are trails that your character leaves behind while walking! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/8880000210c4c377d60dd127a0db47fb367c30f3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Skilling[/h2][p][/p][h3]Cap raised to 40[/h3][p]The biggest change to skilling will be the level cap increase. This has now been raised from 30 to 40, adding new content and unlocks to each skill! I won't be going over the details for each skill in this blog however, so you'll learn those as you get through the skilling catalogue![/p][p][/p][h3]Collection logs[/h3][p]Some new skills will have collections logs added to them. These are rare trinkets that will drop while training your skill. Finding each trinket will increase your player damage by a flat %, meaning that completing a full log will yield decent bonusses for your characters![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/82367d6a32865f95807d7e1b564c04e527dca60a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Speed farming[/h3][p]Got tired of spamming seeds to fill up your farming field? Well, now you can hold shift and click on a seed to plant all of them in a large radius around you! It is also now possible to collect all grown plants automatically by talking to farmer Phil near your farming plots![/p][p][/p][h3]New Glyphs[/h3][p]A new chapter brings along more glyphs! 6 new glyphs are waiting for you to discover their locations spread over the new continent![/p][p][/p][h3]Skilling shops[/h3][p]To offer further purpose to your skilling materials, you will now have certain skilling shops where you can buy outfits/pets/abilities/boosts/... for certain fish/hunting hides/...[/p][p][/p][h2]Controller[/h2][p][/p][h3]Further support[/h3][p]Further support has been added for controllers. More convenience has been added for the following:[/p][list][*][p]Navigating through NPC dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up loot/equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Opening skilling stations[/p][/*][*][p]Navigating the settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Automatically opening cursor-mode when opening complex menu's[/p][/*][*][p]Moving in a circle smoothly now works great on controllers[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Auto-aim[/h3][p] To make combat easier, auto-aim has been added to the settings (on by default for new players).[/p][p]This will automatically target the following in this order:[/p][list][*][p]Incoming Projectiles[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses/Dungeon Bosses[/p][/*][*][p]Regular enemies[/p][/*][/list][p]This will make it so you do not have to aim your melee attacks any longer. You will notice that you get an additional "green aim-circle" while in this mode. This will indicate where your arrows/spells will fire towards. This of course does not work with auto-aim and you must aim these. Can't make it too easy![/p][p][/p][h3]Future[/h3][p]Of course controllers will be continued WIP until they are up to standard to mark the game for full controller support![/p][p][/p][h2]A final note[/h2][p][/p][p]So as you can tell, a whole lot of work has been done in the past 6 months and I'm looking forward to getting more global feedback on what's available! Please bare with me as we work throughout the bugs/crashes that will inevitably appear as the content becomes available. We've been testing thoroughly throughout the beta, but of course we can't catch everything. I appreciate your patience while I work to get through any issues that may appear.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, please discuss any issues/feedback on our Discord or here on Steam (I do read it periodically)!

Thank you so much for your attention, and hopefully we will see you soon in-game![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Development Update - 8th March 2025
notes.notes:
Hi all,

As you may have noticed, the past month it has remained quiet on the update front. That is because I've enabled a lot of the chapter 3 features in the current development branch, marking a point of no return for me. That means that all QoL's that are requested during this period will be added to the chapter 3 patch.

In other words, the next patch that you will see will be the [b]chapter 3 patch, including the multiplayer functionality and the new continent[/b].

To keep you in the loop of what will be added, this development blog will contain most of it. [u][b]Don't enjoy spoilers? Best not to read this one[/b][/u]!

For those that are simply interested in timelines, let me save you the read:
- Chapter 3 will likely be entering beta testing in this month, worst case April.
- Chapter 3 will likely release during summer 2025, this could be June, this could be July or worst case August. All of this will depend on how much balancing is still needed during the beta testing.

To get some more eyes on the game, I will also be entering Incursion2D into Steam Next Fest next round to get some more people on the multiplayer side of the game. If chapter 3 is not running into too many issues, it may already enter the nearest Next Fest, but if not I will delay it until the next one, since these events can only be attended once and we want to have a good impression :)

For the rest of you, let's dive in!

[h2]Continent 3[/h2]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]

As stated in previous devblogs, the next continent will be The Frozen North. A barren frozen landscape where it is nearly always dark. Luckily you'll have a few cozy places to keep you safe during your travels. This continent will introduce you to who the actual endgame boss will be for the game and introduce some extra needed lore for that.
New lands mean new enemies, so this patch will introduce 4 new enemy types and 4 new bosses.
You may see your new challenge in the image below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/65b989f7e81cd38e18ac1a2e6016f4a4879620b1.gif[/img]

(As with previous updates, of course thank you to the artists over at Itch whose credits are mentioned within the game).

From left to right:
1) Frostflame, the ice elemental - accompanied by his army of snakes.
2) Grimskull, the raider - accompanied by her army of goblins.
3) The Frozen Titan - accompanied by his armies of geodes.
4) ??? - accompanied by his army of skeletons.

The final boss is an event that happens during the storyline in The Frozen North and thus I will keep his identity safe for now.

As usual, new mechanics are introduced for you to deal with so expect an increase in difficulty spikes!
These bosses will also include hardmode versions!

And of course, the third arena will be opening its doors as well, so you can chase new hiscores and rewards!

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]

Another big addition to this patch will be multiplayer. Over the past months this has been tested more and more and we feel that it is in quite a stable place. 
Persistent servers will be available for you to play on, and we will monitor the amount of traffic to ensure enough space is available. Latency wise the first servers will be spun up in the EU, if we notice demand in the US or Asia regions, we can easily expand into those areas as well, but we will monitor the demand first. As you know servers aren't free :)

[b]Sharding[/b]

One of the first things I've changed over the past few months is moving from a single server to a sharding system:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/a7ef42b11015ddfa9665bc7ccf1e9d17cbfcd2bb.png[/img]

Servers at this time are capped to 32 players, also here we will see how the performance is. If the shards can handle 32 players with ease, we may increase the playercount. However, due to some decisions made this will have to be evaluated not just based on performance.

Leading into the next point!

[b]Multiplayer interaction[/b]

Last blog we mentioned that multiplayer would be a visual multiplayer, where the online interaction is limited to seeing other players and being able to chat with them.
Since that post the system has been expanded a bit and some new functionality is available:
- Inspecting fellow players and being able to see their equipment and their skill levels
- Multiplayer abilites can now be equipped. These are special abilities that can actually be used on other players inside your server shard. This ranges from healing to buffing others.
- You can now also see the abilities that the other players are casting, besides just seeing the player animations. This setting can be turned off in the settings to assist with visibility.
- Tools have been added for admins to be able to award items ingame or be able to kick/ban(*) players. Moderation is something that will be continously worked on.

Inspecting a player:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/a7002daf56bcff9a9e997a03b19f77f48ebf9f04.gif[/img]
*[i]Founders get a special background![/i]

Healing a player:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/c4d45627dfb504158d96aa460c3b3a79568520a5.gif[/img]

* [i]What does getting banned in this game mean? Your savefile is effectively no longer allowed on any online version. You will retain access to the offline version.[/i]

[b]Future plans[/b]

-In the future we are looking into implementing multiplayer events and bosses in which players can play together at a common goal. Think of event bosses or specific minigames/areas where players can fight the same thing.
-A party system is in the works so that you can only see your party members while playing in combat areas.

[h3]Hunting[/h3]

A new skill will be introduced this patch, which will be the hunting skill! In contrast to the other skills, this will not be bound to a specific area. You will be able to hunt specific animal types in specific continents.

The loop consists of:
- Finding tracks, potentially flushing out animals once found
- Hunting the animal with your ranged weapon (animals will get spooked and run eratically once alerted)
- Collecting their pelts

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/234a12c5149a8941b11ce4756a2e43ece4706d25.gif[/img]

By increasing your hunting level, your tracking radius to spot tracks will increase and your damage to the animal will increase. You will also unlock the ability to spot animals out in the wild without spotting any tracks or potentially running into a nest of multiple animals at once.

If you are lucky, you may encounter a shiny variant of the animal! Hunting down this shiny animal will immediately unlock a cosmetic pet version of this animal for you to show off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/5f2846793491c698189dbd1468c4f1ed6d070403.gif[/img]

The regular pelts can be exchanged at a hunting rack for account bonusses or a cosmetic non-shiny version of the animal whose pelt you are exchanging!

This skill introduces a new stat into the game, which you may have already spotted in the above image. Multishot! Multishot triggers a chance to fire multiple projectiles when shooting your ranged weapon. The multishot chance increases by each hunting level.

At the release of continent 3 you will be able to hunt 6 species of animals.

[h3]Cosmetics[/h3]

Being able to visually diversify your character is what makes chasing goals appealing! When you defeat difficult content in the game, having a cosmetic reward for it should be natural. To increase the customization of your character, two new cosmetic types have been introduced into the game:
- Wings
- Footsteps

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/01bb191ed4707830f70bc6aefc45e1cc11226e60.gif[/img]

By default you will have simple black footsteps available, the rest can be unlocked!

By introducing these new types I would like to move on to the next one.

[h3]Steam Inventory Integration and the in-game store[/h3]

In an attempt to assist with funding the online servers, I need to have a form of monetisation in place that will help pay for these as the game itself is entirely free forever. I've always strictly said that the game should never have any pay-to-win elements, and I maintain that position. The new in-game store will be a simple shop where you can buy additional customization for your characters or your game client. 

Below you can see how it will roughly look like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/08f03244ffc8f6a7419bb0ad40eeadf0c2a3dabd.png[/img]

Most of these cosmetics will be priced at about 250 gemshards, which is about 2.50$. Gemshards and purchased items are available as actual objects in your Steam inventory! Needless to say, these remain on your Steam account and resetting your save file won't affect them. You will always have access to these items for as long as the Steam integration remains functional (which is hopefully forever!). For transparancy, below you can see the pricing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/544128c140d040094f72b25e4ecd32316cdb0fde.png[/img]

Of course a system has been built online where if you run into an issue with your purchase, you can always reach out to me via Discord and I will review your case. If something went wrong, don't panic, I can always award items via the new online servers!

[b]Important[/b]: I also do not believe in FOMO whatsoever. Any item that enters the in-game store will remain there forever. There will not be any situations where certain items will disappear for certain periods.

I know this is usually a sensitive topic so please by all means give me your feedback on what's currently there.

[h3]Chapter 3 unlocks[/h3]

Of course chapter 3 will contain many unlocks (non-premium) for your accounts that don't need to have seperate categories, but you may expect the following (at the time of writing this):
- 30+ new pets will be available for you to collect
- New alchemy vials will open up
- The max tier of your marketplace potions will go up to epic rarity
- 21+ new abilities are available
- 15 new smithing recipes are available

Just for a small sneak peek, here is one of the new abilities:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/0cf48ad0ed9b14c0896a924814cbccb66af2e682.gif[/img]

[h3]The Scribe[/h3]

Much like every continent before this one has had a progression system, a new one will be available in this chapter as well. That new system is the scribe.

The scribe is a cleric that offers you the use of his desk which contains two types of literature:
- Scriptures
- Hymns

To progress in this skill you will need a new currency: paper.
Paper introduces a purpose for those logs you have been collecting so far!

Using a paper station,you can convert logs into paper:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/1584a946254e088958e7150abc581ff163768c00.png[/img]

Additionally, paper will drop in smaller amounts passively from monsters you'll be killing. The tougher the monster, the more paper! Simple!

The desk looks like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/31adc0f48f71482ce2d99d3754a47ef80e9ad65e.png[/img]

Upgrading either a hymn or scripture has a %-based chance of succeeding. Each time you are succesful, you will require more paper and the odds of succeeding will go down. The trade-off is that the stats get better and better the further you go.

Here is an example of a scripture:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/eeb5821af843bc2739657c7c7c2a07fa600cbf35.png[/img]

Here is an example of a hymn:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/b4c9778954c3d144a67560664f4886267969d18b.png[/img]

Scriptures are passive stat increases much like alchemy that will further strengthen your character.
Hymns are combat passives that will invoke based on various conditions while you are fighting. You can only equip one hymn at a time!

I will keep the other effects of the hymns a secret at this time.

[h3]Conclusion[/h3]

So, those are the systems that will be entering beta soon. Please note that the above is simply what is in progress and/or near completion. There is more content in the pipeline for this chapter, but they are not matured enough yet to display. For example I am looking into a proper endgame grind for those of you that reach the complete end of the storyline.

For now, that's all I have. I hope you have a wonderful day and please do let me know your feedback here or on Discord.

Thanks!

notes.title: Development Update - 22nd Aug 2024
notes.notes:
Hello!

Back again with another devlog to show some behind the scenes of what is being worked on. Quite a few things are ready to be pushed for the next patch, but I want some more time to polish it and push some backend changes that will be important for the future of the game.

So expect a new content patch soon, containing some (but not limited) to the things that are showcased today!

Let's dive right into it!

[h2]Continent 3[/h2]
After the second continent, The Empire, was released together with Early Access, work has now begun on the third continent of the game, that being The Frozen North. This will take a different direction from the lush green environments we've been in so far, and focus on a more dark and cold scenery.

This gives the chance to include some additional mechanics (because why not!) that are exclusive to this biome. For example, you'll have to [b]keep an eye on the heat level of your character[/b] while you're in combat and in deep frosted areas, to make sure you don't start suffering cold damage! The areas will also be [b]filled with hazards[/b] that can take you by surprise, in addition to the many mechanics that the monsters of each biome bring along!

To give you a better view into what type of scenery to expect, I'd like to present the next town in which you will spend your time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/e0bcb957a69b5514d41763a408af2a16271335a1.png[/img]

Your encampment for this continent will be one of the very few places that has a cozy and warm vibe going around. The Frozen North also doesn't have a night and day cycle like the other places. Due to the location in the virtual world, this place is permanently enshrouded in a slight darkness. The regular weather also does not apply here. Instead of rain and lightning you will be facing snow, snow storms and blizzards!

The heavy snow can already be seen on the picture above.

As you know the titlescreens evolve throughout your journey. For the third chapter you will unlock following titlescreen:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/54196f9828df79b8154ee47574563f0286ff49ac.png[/img]

And yes, I am looking into making it so you can choose which titlescreen you want featured on your savefile!

Expect more details around this new continent throughout the coming months.

Onto the next then!

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]

Another big topic that I did not expect to discuss this early on in the project lifecycle! As stated in the Steam description for the game, we always wanted to have some form of multiplayer in the game, but we did want to keep the difficulty unique and something you yourself need to get through without any help.

So to get the best of both, the decision has been made to give the players the choice of playing offline or online, where it does not matter which form you pick, the gameplay remains the same.

[b]So what will be the benefit of the online version?[/b]

Well, in this version you will be able to [b]see other players running around[/b] the various different maps, and you will be able to [b]chat with them[/b]. It's a good way to show off the skins/pets/aura's/ranks/... that you have unlocked!

Below you can see a very early WIP image of three clients succesfully connected and interacting with each other:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/86169347bf9e5772022e3b5c630084d36099a7c7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/10d132fcb56b6876271f2e56a9ac20a5a0080c69.png[/img]

So far it's going good! I'll be looking at broadcasting the pets and aura's to all clients next.

For you that may have noticed, you'll see that the chat system is already in place as well!
Any text you send will be sent to the server, holding your username, your message and some information about your steamID. Which reminds me, [b]you can NOT join the online server if you are not online on Steam[/b]! This is because you are not required to make an account for this game. Instead, I will be targetting your steamID and or IP if you perform malicious conduct on the online game. Unfortunately a kick/ban system is always needed!

[b]For those who own the founder pack, you will also get a different color name in the chat[/b]!
The color code looks like this:
- Developpers: Red
- Staff: Green
- Founder Pack owners: Orange
- Server itself: Dark Red

Here you can see an image of the chat in more detail:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/9d5eaa1fa70a8a6be55d988c1f14f9764f19d22b.png[/img]

Anyway, expect more information on this important update coming soon!

[h2]Player Updates[/h2]

In order to prepare your characters for the online update, a few more things will be noticed when you next update the game. Since you don't have to register any accounts with me, I will be using your save files to broadcast to the server. That means that I'll need a few bits of information from you. The most important one, being your username!

Next time you boot up the game after the next patch, you will be prompted to select a username:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/3d0b102e34edf29d2e7f49dfa7a26e78c048aab6.png[/img]

You can pick any name, and it doesn't matter if it overlaps with anyone else. I use your steamID to identify you from other people, so pick whatever you like!

When you do you'll see your name pop up in non-combat areas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/493fd02425500e58fc6220ebbe778a6b12d52dd0.png[/img]

Something else you may notice is that it's not just my name on that screenshot!

Introducing ...

[h3]Hero Ranks![/h3]

Something additional that will be able to show your progress in the game to other players, is your brand new Hero Rank! This will display a badge next to your name, going from rank 0 to rank 10. Hero Ranks will show your mastery of each continent. You will earn 1 Hero Rank for completing Arena Rank 5 of each continent! So this badge will be reserved for the experienced fighters.

The image above displays a rank 1 badge, which will evolve to the following rank 10 badge:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/93240079db7d454254440a232c3d57ce1db40b18.png[/img]

[h3]The Magic Rework![/h3]

Why keep creating flashy new moves when you can only equip 1 special one, right? I agree. So I've decided to make it so the player can now select two special magic abilities at the same time. Duplicates aren't possible, so no, you can't stack frenzy twice!

When you visit the attunement room after next patch you will be greeted with the following:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/f7a73855b490df3bc6516be8df78a50a1cf2d4c0.png[/img]

You will unlock both slots at the same time, as soon as you beat The Nature Golem! Keybinds for these are still F for the primary ability, and E for the secondary ability!

To go along with the coming patch I will be putting in two more abilities. Details on these will be given in the patch notes when it comes out.

[h2]Settings[/h2]

The previous "settings" menu in-game wasn't really a nice settings menu. I've started reworking this menu into something that's a bit more visible with proper sliders. You can see the WIP here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/49824357413f6f5d28ce97570967ea8ebc1b3b05.png[/img]

This will also be available next patch, but I'm currently working on expanding on it and introducing more customizable settings.

... And yes, I will be looking at remapping your keybinds :)

Anywho, that's it for this loaded devlog. That's what's been cooking the past two weeks! Until next time!

notes.title: Content update #1
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Before jumping into the new stuff, I want to announce that the Founder pack is now being sold as DLC!
This pack comes with a few cosmetics for your character, and does NOT grant any in-game advantages. The pack is strictly to help the development of the game. To make this very clear: you will always have access to these items, even after wiping your save files!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/99f2bcd4426e826113f72d38248d0059307daf7a.gif[/img]

[b]That one aside, let's check out the new content![/b]

Today a new patch is available, introducing the ability to swap around your consumables! Gone are the times of just having your trusty old HP and mana potion. As you progress through the game, additional consumables will be unlocked. You will still have to choose between two however, can't have them all!

For this, the interface of the market has been changed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/1d4702296db50d8ea5177cf1cc5d72663f14125c.png[/img]

To change your selection, simply select a consumable, and click the "equip primary" or "equip secondary" to assign it to a slot!

To get started the following items have been added to the market:
- Berserk potion
- Haste potion
- Overshield potion
- Speed potion
- Magnades

Overshield is an entirely new mechanic that increases the survivability of your character. It will grant your character a shield that overlays on top of your health. Meaning the overshield drains before your HP, effectively giving you a second HP bar!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/9f0a80380586498a981c125581a10a30349a276b.png[/img]

For now you can gain overshield just by using the potions, but this effect will be granted through other means later as well.

Besides potions there are now also items that can be thrown, the first being the magnetic grenade! In a tight spot with enemies all around? Group them together by chucking a magnade away from you!

Some small changes were also done to the hit FX, the UI and the start menu controls with a gamepad.

Full patch notes can be found on Discord!

That's all I have for today, thanks for reading!

Hello, prior to today I've been uploading devlogs every few weeks onto the page over on Itch, but I will start updating the page here as well to ensure visibility to those that want it.

I will start with summarizing the updates over the past few months, and then move onto today's news!

[h1]January 16th 2024[/h1]

[h2]New areas[/h2]

[h2]Fishing[/h2]
This skill won't be as much click&wait, but rather be a minigame where you must actively chase the fish to catch it. Catching larger and rarer fish mean more XP, and more materials that you'll be able to exchange at the fishing vendor for a suite of rewards. Each new fish type will also unlock new vials in the alchemy skill. Can you catch the elusive legendary quality huge fish at 0.0001% spawn rate? Probably not! Here's what you would be looking out for:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795926/fc0766da7f9da0d9ad8c88954f6d6b433ed51d7e.png[/img]

You control the fishing bobber with your <WASD> movement, and hit <SPACEBAR> to attempt to catch a fish. You will have to actively chase the fish shadows, until your proximity circle turns green, marking a potential catch. Higher rarity fish will be marked with a lootbeam on the water, alerting you of the urgency to catch it, since they can disappear quite quick! Your bobber has a stamina bar that you can use to move faster, but keep in mind it recharges slowly. Your fishing efficiency/speed increases with the skill level. I'll have more details on this skill as it develops.

[h2]Controller support[/h2]
As was stated on the roadmap, controller support is something I'd love to have. So for the current development build I've passed a first batch for the controller support. It's not final at all and still requires a lot of work, but as of now it's fully possible to play the entire game with a controller without needing to use the keyboard for anything. In a second batch I will look at making the menu's more controller-friendly as well as being able to manipulate the dialogue system with your buttons rather than needing a cursor to navigate.

[h2]New enemies and rewards[/h2]
As with the previous area you will be facing 4 new bosses in this zone as well as 4 new enemy types. As of now the first boss and its enemy types are finished, with their combat areas currently being designed. Defeating the first boss unlocks a new type of ability you will be able to cast, in addition to the previously available kit! The new ability type will be available with the <F> key, and is an alternative magic spell! Which leads me to the following:

[h2]Changes[/h2]
Seeing as ranged was a swappable combat style, it only made sense to do the same for basic magic attacks. We have removed them from the <F> key and assigned a swappable class for it. You will now switch to the magic style in the same way you swap to ranged by hitting <Q>, and then using left click to fire your basic attacks. You are also able to swap between all three modes using 1-2-3.

While I haven't started on it yet, there will be a major overhaul to the mining/woodcutting aspect of the game. They will be removed as they are currently being used and converted into dedicated skills, much like fishing. Dedicated areas will be created and you'll be able to actually progress the skill itself, while gathering materials for your own island!

There are many changes planned to the player island as well, to make sure that the island serves a decent useful purpose for your adventures, I'll be posting more about that later.
